name: AddNoteToContact
label: Add Note to Salesforce Contact
description: Adds a note (CaseComment or custom) to a Salesforce Contact via related object or custom logic.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact to add the note to (required).

fields.name: NoteText
fields.label: Note Text
fields.description: The text content of the note to add.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after adding the note.
